# ChangeKind real-extraction coverage

Which `ChangeKind`s are named by at least one *real end-to-end* evidence source (a compiled catalog case, a field-shape fixture, or an `integration`-marked test that asserts the kind), as opposed to unit tests on hand-built snapshots only. A kind with zero sources may have a detector the real extractors never feed. The zero-source set is a shrink-only baseline (`scripts/changekind_real_coverage_baseline.json`, gated by `tests/test_changekind_real_coverage.py`). The integration column is a lexical AST scan; its limits are in the script's `scan_integration_tests` docstring.
